request: a case for an Apple AirTag (the 2021 one)

body_sources.w: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, AirTag Dimensional Drawings sheet 1, outer ring 'Ø 31.87')
body_sources.h: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, side view, top of dome '7.98' above datum '0.00' at the back plate)

features.name: speaker_keepout
features.source: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, top view above the side view, third angle projection per title block: note 1 'SPEAKER KEEPOUT. DO NOT OBSTRUCT THIS AREA Ø 25.75', centered; note 1 'CASE SHOULD NOT OBSTRUCT ACOUSTIC AREA')

why: Dome up (+z), steel back plate down: the case wraps the whole tag but must leave Apple's Ø25.75 speaker keepout on the dome open; round body as a box with corner_r half the diameter.
